sources.outlet: UN DESA, Committee for Development Policy, 2026 Monitoring Report: Senegal
sources.quote: Total debt service reached 41.8 per cent of exports of goods, services and primary income in 2024
sources.searcher_note: Same measure family (debt service / exports) for Senegal, but 2024 actual debt service, not 2026 scheduled. Report dated March 2026 on its cover; data current as of 5 Feb 2026. WebFetch got 403; curl fetched the PDF and the sentence is in it.

sources.outlet: World Bank / IMF, Senegal Joint Bank-Fund Debt Sustainability Analysis
sources.quote: The external debt service to exports ratio marginally breaches the risk threshold in 2026 with Eurobond amortizations coming due
sources.searcher_note: Pre-hidden-debt DSA (circa 2023; refers to the June 2022 vintage as previous). Flags 2026 as the debt-service-to-exports spike from Eurobond amortization, matching the lead's caveat. Its projected 2026 total external debt service-to-exports is 27.2% (PPG 21.8%), far below the lead's 54%; different definition and a 2023 projection.

sources.quote: In 2026 they are due to go over 50% of government revenue.
sources.searcher_note: Senegal government external debt payments due in 2026 over 50% of revenue. Revenue, not exports, as denominator. No country ranking.

sources.quote: JPMorgan's calculation showed Senegal owes $9.7-billion in interest and amortisation this year, $7.8-billion in 2027 and $8.7-billion in 2028.
sources.searcher_note: Total debt service (includes regional/domestic), 2026 higher than 2027 but not the 2026-28 peak by much. Different scope than the lead's $4.44B external figure; no exports ratio.

sources.quote: Senegal's debt service is expected to double in 2026, increasing from about $1.1 billion in 2025 to more than $2.2 billion.
sources.searcher_note: Possible disagreement on the 2026 amount ($2.2B vs lead's $4.44B), scope unstated (likely external commercial/Eurobond). Also says the pressure comes from a single ~$1.1B payment in May 2026 linked to eurobond maturities, matching the lead's ~$1.06B bond caveat.

sources.quote: Sur les 5 801,38 milliards prévus, 4 516,21 milliards sont destinés au remboursement du principal, contre 1 285,17 milliards pour les intérêts et commissions.
sources.searcher_note: Post-cutoff (French). Total public debt service for 2026 in the revised budget: 5,801.38 bn CFA francs (Barclays estimates 6,800 bn). Total, not external; no exports ratio.

notes: No source found stating Senegal's 2026 scheduled external debt service as ~54% of exports, or ranking Senegal first (or Bhutan second) among 108 LMICs on that ratio. The lead notes the World Bank publishes the ratio itself; the IDS/IDR 2025 PDF and data portal were found but no page quoting the 2026 projection was opened. Same-entity sources use other measures: 41.8% of exports in 2024 (UN DESA, actual); 27.2% of exports in 2026 (2023 World Bank/IMF DSA projection, pre-hidden-debt); over 50% of revenue in 2026 (Debt Justice); $2.2B (Ecofin), $9.7B total incl. domestic (JPMorgan via Reuters), 5,801 bn CFA total (Senegal budget via Senego). Post-cutoff items: Senego 2026-09-23; Credendo 2026-09-11 (https://credendo.com/en/knowledge-hub/senegal-debt-restructuring-announced-after-hidden-debt-crisis) reports the 1 Sept 2026 IMF staff-level agreement and planned external debt restructuring, no debt-service ratio, not recorded. FinDevLab policy note (Jan 2026) opened; no exports ratio.
